gates.name: Precise theorem-shaped statement
gates.question: Can the candidate be stated as a formula, law, or divergence rather than a visual impression?

gates.name: Exact finite-field interpretation
gates.question: Is there an exact F_q[t] object or known algebraic mechanism on the theorem side?

gates.name: Integer-prime holdout evidence
gates.question: Was an integer-prime analogue preregistered and checked on unseen ranges?

gates.name: Local/null/random controls
gates.question: Does the candidate beat local baselines, random controls, and known leakage/placebo tests?

gates.name: Compression / low parameter count
gates.question: Is the rule simpler than the data and not explained by tuning many fitted knobs?

gates.name: Scale and field stability
gates.question: Does the result survive changes in degree, q, range, or normalization?

gates.name: Novelty audit
gates.question: Is it not just a renamed known theorem, local obstruction, or plotting artifact?

gates.name: Plausible proof path

gates.name: Expert-ready evidence pack

precise_statement.evidence: Candidate states a fixed joint splitting-type residual for two cubic Kummer covers on each side: x^3-2/x^3-5 over Z and x^3-t/x^3-(t+1) over F_q[t].

finite_field_anchor.evidence: F_q[t] side is exact: monic irreducibles P define finite residue fields, and the joint class is computed by cube-residue splitting of t and t+1.

integer_holdout.evidence: Integer side checks endpoints 1000000, 2000000, 4000000 for joint splitting type over unramified primes.

controls.evidence: Observed joint splitting residuals are inside preregistered product-Chebotarev multinomial controls; no anomaly survives.

compression.evidence: Low-parameter statistic: two fixed cubic covers per universe, nine fixed joint classes, and product Chebotarev baselines.

scale_stability.evidence: Scale gate requires complete 1M/2M/4M/8M ladder and a control-surviving residual. Complete ladder=false; all within controls=true.

novelty_audit.evidence: No novelty audit has found structure beyond known Chebotarev/Kummer character independence; the residual is calibration-only at this scale.

reproducibility.evidence: JSON/MD/SVG/script artifacts are present and generated by the joint Chebotarev residual script.

proof_path.evidence: The joint residual lies inside controls and has no proof path beyond standard Chebotarev/Kummer equidistribution.

expert_pack.evidence: No expert-ready breakthrough pack exists because controls, scale stability, novelty, and proof path gates fail.

theoremShape.integer: joint factorization type of x^3-2 and x^3-5 modulo unramified rational primes p
theoremShape.functionField: joint factorization type of x^3-t and x^3-(t+1) over residue fields F_q[t]/P
theoremShape.expectedFieldRule: if q^deg(P)-1 is divisible by 3, split/inert joint densities are product 1/3 by 2/3; otherwise linear+quadratic/linear+quadratic is deterministic
